title: Pennies for Your Thoughts: Costly Product Consideration and Purchase Quantity Thresholds
eligible_reason: Descriptive evidence on purchase-quantity thresholds and a structural model of costly consideration; regressions of quantity/purchase on (log) price with household or store FE. No policy adoption or DiD.
design_notes: main_evidence.do/supporting_evidence.do: xtreg buys/logvolume/logunits on logprice (and lags) with quarter/year dummies, lpoly plots; MATLAB likelihood estimation and counterfactuals on simulated data.
data_files_note: IRI academic data must be obtained separately (external/ placeholder); structural code runs on data simulated from estimates.
data_provenance_note: IRI data not shipped; sim_data.m generates simulated data.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ empty for this suffix); screened from README, code, data and the OpenAlex abstract. Out of scope.
